title: raw-108 operation-3 class-mask PercentFirstEffect factor ignores overlapping class-mask bit multiplicity
evidence: core: every other class-mask SpellMod path uses the overlap popcount: Percent ops raise the binary32 factor to the count (:172-185, spellmod_percent_factor :477-483); flat cooldown and flat first-effect multiply points by count (:596, :673). compile_percent_first_effect_projections computes factor = 1 + points/100 once (:544) and only tests count > 0 (:574).

trinity: SpellInfo.cpp:2005-2008 returns the popcount as applyCount; Player.cpp GetSpellModValues multiplies pct by pow(1 + value/100, applyCount) for every SpellModOp including PointsIndex0 (Object.cpp:1678-1690 ApplyEffectModifiers applies PointsIndex0 to effect-0 values).
probe: provider +50% op 3 mask 0b11, raw-20 payload 1%/1000hp: one overlapping bit -> 15.0, two bits -> 15.0 (Trinity 22.5); flat raw-107 op 3 sibling path gives 20.0 / 30.0 (counts bits).
source: no 12.1.0 raw-108 op-3 trait provider has a >=2-bit overlap with any same-family spell (scratch/B/scan_pfe.py), so the defect is reachable only with source-shaped synthetic inputs today.
why_tests_missed: The only admitted op-3 percent witness (Ephemeral Bond) uses the Boolean label selector; no Core test constructs a class-mask PercentFirstEffect provider, and the class-mask branch percent_first_effect_class_mask (selected_trait_package.rs:1125) is reachable only through the arity-1 composition shortcut.
correction_boundary: compile_percent_first_effect_projections: derive the factor from selector_match_count exactly as the Percent branch does (binary32 (1+p/100)^count), or reject class-mask PercentFirstEffect at classification until a witness exists.
must_not_widen: Do not widen op-3 percent to new target shells (raw-87, direct payloads) while fixing multiplicity; keep label selector Boolean.

title: arity-1 composition admits sole-effect op-3 percent providers (raw-108 class-mask and raw-218 label) outside every implemented catalog row
evidence: core: composition_is_admitted_by returns true for arity 1 (:889) before any role/slot check, so generic_spell_modifier roles PercentFirstEffect(ClassMask) and PercentFirstEffect(Label) become executable as sole effects.
core: raw-108 catalog row (aura_subtype.rs:440-450) documents only operations 0/22/11/15; raw-218 row (:488) admits operation 3 only for the exact complete three-effect Ephemeral Bond package.
probe: sole-effect one-rank raw-218 op-3 label provider (+50) compiles, binds and scales a raw-20 tick 10 -> 15; raw-108 op-3 class-mask sole provider compiles (CSA-B-01 probe).
why_tests_missed: Catalog-row tests assert documented witnesses compile; no test asserts that undocumented sole-effect op-3 shapes are refused.
correction_boundary: Either document the generic arity-1 op-3 admission in the raw-108/raw-218 rows (with CSA-B-01/04 fixed) or restrict PercentFirstEffect roles to the explicit arity-3 Ephemeral Bond slot.
must_not_widen: Do not add new composition slots to paper over the gap.

title: operation-15 CritDamageAndHealing projections are compiled only for payloads with damage impacts, so matching pure heals crit without the bonus while mixed-program heals receive it
evidence: core: percent_payloads(CriticalBonus) = critical_damage_spell_modifier_payload_spells, i.e. programs having an impact that is crit-eligible AND has_damage AND a damage-family op (payload_spells.rs:32-52). No projection exists for a pure-heal payload, and nothing rejects an admitted provider whose family/mask matches one.

core: prepare_impact_critical applies critical_bonus_multiplier to every crit-eligible impact, heals included (bonus_before_school when !has_damage, critical.rs:34-76), keyed only by (actor, payload spell).
trinity: Unit.cpp:7309-7317 SpellCriticalHealingBonus applies SpellModOp::CritDamageAndHealing to healing crits; Unit.cpp:7296-7301 to damage.

probe: same provider (+20% op 15) and same family/mask: damage crit 200 -> 220; pure DirectHeal crit 200 -> 200; heal impact of a program that also deals damage 200 -> 220. Exact Awestruck 417855 provider shape vs Flash of Light 19750 mask: heal 200, damage 220.

source: sole-effect one-rank raw-108 op-15 trait providers whose masks overlap same-family heals exist in 12.1.0: Awestruck 417855 (Flash of Light 19750, Holy Shock 25914, Holy Light 82326), Intensity 1264649 (Regrowth 8936), Profound Rebuttal 392910 (Expel Harm); Angelic Touch 1250565 and Tigereye Brew 1261844 are two-effect. Catalog row states healing remains unchanged only because the Martial Expert population has no healing carrier (aura_subtype.rs:450), an argument the generic arity-1 admission no longer satisfies.
why_tests_missed: Op-15 tests use Martial Expert / Heart of the Crusader whose family-4/10 masks match no heal carrier; there is no test with a matching heal payload, and the mixed damage+heal program case is not modelled.
correction_boundary: Compile CriticalBonus projections over crit-eligible damage AND healing payloads (the runtime consumer already handles heals), or fail closed at compile when an op-15 provider matches a crit-eligible heal payload; make the decision keyed on the healing impact rather than on a sibling damage impact.
must_not_widen: Do not apply op 15 to raw-20 periodic percent heals or other impacts Trinity does not route through SpellCriticalHealingBonus; keep 1+(M-1)F excess semantics.

title: selected op-3 PointsIndex0 providers bind and compile but are silently inert on every matching first effect other than declared raw-87/raw-20 slices
evidence: core: compile_flat_first_effect_projections iterates only damage_modifiers (raw-87 self) and periodic_heals (raw-20 self) targets and `continue`s over everything else (:625-660); compile_percent_first_effect_projections only raw-20 (:552-572). A matching SchoolDamage/Heal/any other effect-1 payload yields no projection and no error.
core: raw-107 catalog row (aura_subtype.rs:439) claims "unrelated first-effect lowerers ... remain fail-closed"; raw-219 row (:489) likewise.
trinity: WorldObject::ApplyEffectModifiers (Object.cpp:1678-1690) applies PointsIndex0 to effect 0 of every affected spell.

probe: sole-effect selected +10 raw-107 op-3 and +50% raw-108 op-3 providers with mask matching a SchoolDamage payload: compile, bind, damage stays 100 (Trinity 110 / 150); op-0 control on the same pair gives 150.

source: 12.1.0 trait op-3 providers overlapping direct damage/heal first effects are all multi-effect (Frigid Winds 235224, Soul Link 108415, Blighted Quiver 1264291, Recklessness 1719, Power of the Dream 434220) and currently rejected by composition, so no real package reaches this today.
why_tests_missed: Op-3 tests only build admitted raw-87/raw-20 targets or missing-label cases; none declares an ordinary payload that also matches the provider.
correction_boundary: In the op-3 projection compilers, reject (typed build error) any declared program payload whose first effect matches the provider selector but is not an admitted target shell.
must_not_widen: Do not implement generic PointsIndex0 over arbitrary effect lowerers as part of the fix.

title: raw-108 catalog row and op-0 payload set claim direct missing-or-maximum healing, but the executable heal path never applies ordinary or SpellMod multipliers to it
evidence: core: direct_spell_modifier_payload_spells includes ProgramOp::DirectMissingOrMaximumHeal, so an op-0 projection is compiled for such payloads; quote_healing returns apply_modifiers=false for HealingFormulaKind::MissingOrMaximum (health.rs:1447-1476), so apply_healing_amount_modifiers never evaluates healing_multiplier/spell_modifier_projection for it.
core: raw-108 row (aura_subtype.rs:444) lists "direct missing-or-maximum healing" among op-0 targets while the raw-67 row (spell_effect.rs:245) says its amount bypasses healing-percentage modifiers.

trinity: EffectHealMaxHealth adds to m_healing without SpellHealingBonusDone (SpellEffects.cpp:2966-2987), so executable Core matches the direct consumer; only the catalog claim and the compiled projection are wrong/dead.
probe: op-0 +20% provider matching a raw-67 caster-maximum heal: 2e6 with and without binding; matching raw-10 heal 240.
why_tests_missed: No test combines a matching op-0 provider with a raw-67 payload.
correction_boundary: Remove DirectMissingOrMaximumHeal from direct_spell_modifier_payload_spells and correct the raw-108 row wording.
must_not_widen: Do not start applying op 0 to raw-67 heals (Trinity does not).
